fill_timing.costs: event-engine defaults: volume-proportional slippage, no commission
fill_timing.takeaway: Over the full sample (2014-01-02 to 2023-08-30, fixed parameters, event-engine defaults: volume-proportional slippage, no commission), same-bar fills overstated total return by 1.3 pp (-3.7% vs -5.0% with next-bar-open fills). Bars are rebuilt from closes, so each open is the previous close.

walk_forward.takeaway: Out of sample, over 7 stitched one-year test windows (2016-11-25 to 2023-08-30, next-bar fills, 0.1% commission + 0.1% slippage per trade, parameters refit each window), the strategy returned -4.0% against -19.3% for buy-and-hold (no costs).

sharpe_uncertainty.takeaway: Out-of-sample Sharpe -0.37, 95% interval -1.11 to 0.43; DSR 0.0 after 28 trials (not significant at 0.95).

cost_sensitivity.takeaway: Sharpe is not positive even at 0 bps (-0.36). Each level charges that many bps of commission and of slippage per trade.
